micro.method: Independent processes; Release -O3; sequential shuffled schedule; warm filesystem; no OS cache flush; write includes close+rename, no fsync; excludes server initialization/project parsing; no runtime dependency scan; PackageAnalysis semantic diagnostics forced

memory.scope: 20ms sampled parent/family memory, no semantic diagnostic children; ordinary sequence cut at final edit; complete cut includes error/repair, suffix macros, save and explicit rebuild in BOTH arms; observations not statistical bounds
